tasks.label: Stop Foundry VTT
tasks.command: $pids = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 443 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | Where-Object { $_ -ne 0 }; if ($pids) { $pids | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; $pids | ForEach-Object { try { Wait-Process -Id $_ -Timeout 10 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {} }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 }; exit 0

tasks.label: Link to Foundry
tasks.command: node scripts/build-css.js; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; $path = 'C:\FoundryVTT\Data\systems\dolmenwood'; $target = Get-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($target -and $target.LinkType) { Write-Host 'Foundry system folder is linked to this repo'; exit 0 }; if ($target) { Write-Host 'Foundry system folder is a plain copy - replacing it with a link to this repo'; cmd /c rmdir /s /q "$path"; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path) { Write-Error 'Could not remove the Foundry system folder (is Foundry still running?)'; exit 1 } }; New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path $path -Target '${workspaceFolder}' | Out-Null; Write-Host 'Linked Foundry system folder to this repo'

tasks.label: FVTT Pack - Pack
tasks.command: $packs = Get-ChildItem -Path packs -Directory | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name; fvtt package workon dolmenwood --type System; foreach ($pack in $packs) { fvtt package pack $pack --in "packs/$pack/src" --out "packs" }

tasks.label: FVTT Pack - Unpack + Sync
tasks.command: $packs = Get-ChildItem -Path packs -Directory | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name; fvtt package workon dolmenwood --type System; foreach ($pack in $packs) { fvtt package unpack $pack --out "packs/$pack/src" }; Copy-Item -Path 'C:\FoundryVTT\Data\systems\dolmenwood\packs\*' -Destination 'packs' -Recurse -Force
